profile.name: Zijian Yang
profile.bio: Hi! I’m Zijian Yang, a Ph.D. student at the College of Design and Innovation, Tongji University. I study how people can guide AI in creating data visualizations and data stories. My current research focuses on using sketches to communicate design intent and evaluating how AI agents review and refine the charts they generate.
